The Academy

Where champions
are built, not born

Legend Martial Arts & Sports Academy is home to anyone aspiring to become a legend and unleash the real potential within them. Our students train in genuine Mixed Martial Arts — Karate, Kickboxing, Thai Boxing, Muay Thai and Judo — inside one structured curriculum built around discipline, respect and real technique.

Every class runs for 1.5 hours, in a proper karate uniform, guided by black belt instructors who've trained district, state, national and international champions. New students get a 2-day trial before they commit.

What We Train

Five arts. One academy.

Experienced, structured training across the full spectrum of mixed martial arts — taught with equal seriousness whether you're 5 or 15.

Karate

Traditional striking, forms and discipline at the core of every Legend student's journey.

Kickboxing

Power, speed and combinations — the discipline behind our international championship medals.

Muay Thai

The art of eight limbs — clinch work, elbows and knees taught with proper technique and control.

Thai Boxing

Conditioning-driven striking that builds stamina, timing and fight-ready confidence.

Judo

Throws, grips and grappling fundamentals rooted in balance, leverage and respect.

On The Calendar

Belt examination cycle

Three checkpoints a year to test, promote and push every student one step closer to black.

February

First belt examination of the year — the opening checkpoint for every student's progress.

July

Mid-year examination, testing technique built up over a full training cycle.

November

Year-end examination — the final promotion window before the next training year begins.

Join Legend

How admission works

01

Who can join

Anyone aspiring to become a legend and unleash the real potential in them — ages 3 to 18.

02

Take the trial

Every new student trains for 2 days before committing, in a proper karate uniform.

03

Sign the consent form

A consent form is handed to the student in class at the end of the trial period.

04

Submit your documents

A Xerox copy of the student's Aadhar Card is required to complete admission.

Admission at a glance

  • Minimum age3 years
  • Maximum age18 years
  • Trial period2 days
  • Required documentAadhar Card copy
  • UniformKarate dress + L.M.A shirt
  • Class duration1.5 hours

Fee structure and academy rules are shared directly during the admission process. Reach out to start your trial.
